user.title: Schulportal Hessen
user.description: Set up a child and its Schulportal Hessen account. Individual modules can be disabled; disabled modules do not fetch data.

error.invalid_school_id: The school ID must be numeric.
error.invalid_child: The child name and shortcut must not be empty.

init.title: Configure Schulportal Hessen
init.description: Change the login credentials, school ID, child information, update interval, calendar event types, or active modules. Disabled modules do not fetch data from Schulportal; their sensors/calendars remain empty. Calendar event types can be freely extended as a comma-separated list; Arbeiten and Klausuren are used by default. The integration will be reloaded automatically afterwards.

error.invalid_school_id: The school ID must be numeric.
error.invalid_child: The child name and shortcut must not be empty.
